data.name: Roscoe
data.long_meaning: The name Roscoe originated from the Old English words 'ros' meaning 'dew' and 'cu' meaning 'power, strength'. The name Roscoe is of Anglo-Saxon origin and is a masculine name. It was used to describe someone who was powerful and had the strength of dew, representing the vigor and freshness of new beginnings.
